title: Influence-Directed Distillation: Solving the Diversity Bottleneck in Sampled-Token On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.29846v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampled-token on-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from teacher to student using student-generated tokens, requiring teacher probabilities only for sampled tokens. Yet it frequently suffers from diversity distillation failure: the student's pass@1 improves while its pass@$k$ plateaus, failing to inherit the teacher's diversity. To explain this, we introduce First-Order Local Entropy Influence, a signed first-order proxy that decouples each update's entropy effect into the teacher--student log-probability gap and the student's local probability structure, and empirically links entropy contraction to negative-influence positions. translated_title: 影响导向蒸馏：解决采样Token在线策略蒸馏中的多样性瓶颈
translated_abstract: 采样Token在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过使用学生模型自身生成的Token，仅需对采样到的Token获取教师模型的概率，从而高效地将教师模型的能力迁移至学生模型。然而该方法经常出现“多样性蒸馏失败”问题：学生模型的pass@1指标提升，但其pass@k指标停滞不前，无法继承教师模型的多样性。为解释这一现象，我们提出一阶局部熵影响，这是一个带符号的一阶代理指标，将每次更新的熵效应解耦为教师-学生对数概率差距和学生模型的局部概率结构，并实证地将熵收缩与负影响位置关联起来。受此启发，我们提出影响导向自适应在线策略蒸馏：它不再依赖代价高昂的全词表前向KL目标，而是保留扩展熵的更新，同时用散度自适应的优势收缩来替换收缩熵的更新
tldr: 提出影响导向自适应在线策略蒸馏（IDA-OPD），利用一阶局部熵影响指标识别并替换导致熵收缩的负影响更新，在不依赖全词表前向KL计算的情况下解决了采样Token在线策略蒸馏中学生模型多样性丢失的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Influence-Directed Adaptive On-Policy Distillation (IDA-OPD), which uses First-Order Local Entropy Influence to identify and replace entropy-contracting updates, solving the diversity distillation failure in sampled-token on-policy distillation without relying on costly full-vocabulary Forward-KL objectives.
